title: A quantum chemical convolutional neural network model for predicting thermodynamics and kinetics of DNA molecules from sequences
authors: Likun Wang; Hao Pei; Tong Zhu
one_liner_zh: 该文用量子化学计算与卷积神经网络预测DNA双链热力学和链置换动力学，虽涉及DNA序列-性质预测，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上对AI预测DNA性质有间接参考价值。
abstract: Accurate predicting thermodynamics and kinetics of DNA molecules are important for designing oligonucleotides in biotechnological applications, but current models in use are not accurate enough. Here, we propose a model combining quantum chemical calculations and convolutional neural networks (QCM) to predict the free energies of DNA duplexes and rate constants of DNA strand displacement reactions. The QCM achieves better accuracy than previous models on two limited datasets by active learning, the accuracy of predicting free energies of duplexes is 23% better than the nearest neighbor model, and the accuracy of predicting rate constants of strand displacement reactions is 60% better than the worm-like chain model.
abstract_zh: 准确预测DNA分子的热力学和动力学对于生物技术应用中寡核苷酸的设计至关重要，但当前使用的模型精度不足。在此，我们提出一种结合量子化学计算和卷积神经网络（QCM）的模型，用于预测DNA双链体的自由能及DNA链置换反应的速率常数。通过主动学习，QCM在两个有限数据集上的精度优于先前模型，预测双链体自由能的精度比最近邻模型提高23%，预测链置换反应速率常数的精度比蠕虫链模型提高60%。
